title: Hackers are leaked into the network of sex video actors Pavel Dereevyanko
text:
At actor Pavel Dereevyanko, the Telegram account was hacked. The hacker leaked his intimate video with a girl online and managed to dilute some of the actors' friends for money and writing.
Dereevyanko account falls into the hands of today's crooks at 16:00. For three hours, the attackers managed to increase two plans: personal video distribution from the contacts and request money, quoting a blocked account. The old actor's old driver was arrested and transferred 48,000 rubles.
According to Dereevyanko, his girlfriend Zoya Futz is very worried about what happened. The actor himself called on those who registered not to trust the scammers.
Dereevyanko has not contacted the police.
